content: ESA - Europe reclaims a stake in Mars exploration Science & Exploration Europe reclaims a stake in Mars exploration 10/04/2003 8216 views 31 likes ESA / Science & Exploration / Space Science / Mars Express From the Greeks more than two thousand years ago to Eugene Antoniadi in the mid 1900s, Europeans have made many important observations of Mars with the naked eye and through Earth-bound telescopes. They have even contributed their fair share of speculation and fantasy about the planet in a fine tradition beginning in 1897 with the publication of The War of the Worlds by H.G. Wells in which hostile Martians invade Earth. Europe, however, had never sent its own spacecraft to Mars until 2003.
